steps.description:
Create a program that asks the user to enter the coordinates of 2 points and draw a line between them.

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input -99,30 50,-27

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the example below: Point A: -99,30 Point B: 50,-27

Check the screen dimension using window_width() and window_height() commands and draw a horzontal line and a vertical line across the center of the screen. Set your turtle speed to 0 as this may take a while to be drawn.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)
